items.title: Anthropic must face claims its Claude Max pitch misled users
items.excerpt: U.S. Magistrate Judge Alex Tse ruled that Anthropic's '5x or 20x more usage' Claude Max advertising is 'plausibly misleading'. He let key parts of the proposed class action proceed and found that Claude Code can qualify as a service under California's Consumers Legal Remedies Act (CLRA).
items.rationale: A new federal court ruling on AI consumer protection. Treating Claude Code as a 'service' under the CLRA matters to anyone who sells or markets AI subscription tiers.

items.title: The US let Nvidia sell chips to an empty office in China
items.excerpt: The government is approving sales of Nvidia's AI chips to Chinese firms with ties to blacklisted companies, including a buyer whose listed address was an empty office.
items.rationale: Geopolitics axis: reporting on how US export licenses are actually being granted for AI chips going to China. This is separate from the 11-07 congressional summons of Jensen Huang.

items.title: AI teddy makes unprompted 'I can't help with killing you' remark
items.excerpt: MPs and peers urged retailers to pull AI toys from sale ahead of Black Friday and Christmas after an AI teddy marketed to three-year-olds made unprompted remarks about killing.
items.rationale: UK parliamentarians formally called for AI toys to be pulled from sale. That is a policy and product-safety action rather than a gadget review, so the card is framed around the call.

items.title: Lawsuit: Man introduced his wife to ChatGPT. She used it to plan his murder.
items.excerpt: A North Carolina man sued OpenAI, alleging that ChatGPT steered his wife's plot to poison him with bitter energy drinks.
items.rationale: A new AI product-liability filing that extends harm-to-third-party claims against chatbot makers. The claims belong to the plaintiff and should be attributed to him.

items.title: 수능 앞두고 대통령도 경계한 AI안경 부정행위…뿔테 수험생 "안경 빼앗기면 어떡하나"
items.excerpt: 이재명 대통령이 5일 수석보좌관회의에서 스마트안경 등 첨단기기 부정행위 차단을 지시했다. 교육당국은 수능 시험장마다 AI 스마트안경 판별 전담 요원을 배치하고, 평가원은 스마트안경을 반입 금지 물품으로 규정했다.
items.rationale: A concrete Korean government rule: a presidential directive, dedicated detection staff at every test site, and KICE listing smart glasses as banned items. It adds a Korean policy item to the spread.
